verdict.rationale: Anrok's API covers many core objects: customers (create, retrieve, list), the transaction lifecycle (createEphemeral, createOrUpdate, negation, void), certificate upload (explicitly via both UI and API), filings retrieval, product mappings, address resolution and tax-ID validation. Its Headless Tax pitch says tax can run through APIs or agents. However, no evidence asserts API/UI parity, and UI features such as exposure dashboards, registration handling, nexus tracking/alerts and the AI Atlas Q&A have no documented API equivalents. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API endpoints for registrations, nexus monitoring/alerts, exposure dashboards and filing management beyond fetch, and independent corroboration.
